title: Jabby Spears/Skewers
description: this resource pack makes spears shorter, kind of like those short swords/daggers resource packs
body:
spears for toddlers lol

do people even use spears in pvp? i dont think so, but eh, whatever. made this pack anyway.

if the pack says its incompatible just turn it on anyway, the pack still works.. atleast for me it does
